question: Find the latest MX1 Bill of Materials and summarize what it covers.
answer:
Here is a comprehensive summary of all three latest MX1 Bills of Materials:

---

## MX1 Bills of Materials — Summary

There are **three BOM documents** in the corpus, each covering a distinct aspect of the MX1 Portable X-ray System.

---

### 1. BOM-055 Rev G — MX1 Top-Level Assembly (Hardware)
<cite>BOM-055 Rev G</cite>

This is the **top-level hardware assembly BOM** for the complete MX1 system as shipped. It defines what is included in the shipping configuration:

| Line Item | Description | Qty |
|---|---|---|
| E1 (BOM-004, Rev K) | Emitter | 1 |
| C1 (BOM-008, Rev L) | Cassette | 1 |
| H1 (BOM-019, Rev D) | Wired Charger | 2 |
| P1 (BOM-037, Rev G) | Pelican Case | 1 |
| M10637 Rev B | Physical IFU-MX1 Booklet | 1 |
| M11177 Rev A | Physical MX1 Emergency Instructions Booklet | 1 |
| MS-10627 (BOM-056, Rev F) | Puck Box with Pucks | 1 |
| MS-10334 Rev C | Overshipper Assembly | 1 |
| M50703 | Packaging Tape, Clear, 2" | 1 |

The **Overshipper Assembly** (MS-10334) itself breaks down into a cardboard overshipper box, an overshipper label, a standardized GTIN label, and a UN 3481 (lithium battery) label.

**Revision History Highlights:** Rev G (the latest) updated the Emitter to BOM Rev K, the Cassette to BOM Rev L, the Pelican Case to BOM Rev G, the Puck Box to BOM Rev F, and revised the overshipper label from Rev B to C — all driven by ECR-593.

---

### 2. BOM-079 Rev P — MX1 Software System v3.4.0 (Detailed Hardware BOM)
<cite>BOM-079 Rev P</cite>

Despite "Software System" in its title, this is a **very detailed hardware component-level BOM** organized across multiple assembly sheets, covering all three primary hardware assemblies:

- **ASM-100 — Imager Emitter Assembly**: Covers the full X-ray emitter including the 60 kV X-ray tube (Micro X-Ray), IR and visible imaging cameras, LIDAR PCB, laser PCB, OLED display, beam-limiting pucks (in five SID sizes: 20.0, 26.3, 32.5, 38.8, and 45.0 cm, plus a 5×5 puck), fixed collimator, aluminum filter disk, high-voltage shields, enclosure halfshells, gaskets, harnesses, and all fasteners/adhesives.

- **ASM-200 — Imager Control Unit Assembly**: Covers the control box including a Spellman 65 kV high-voltage power supply, Intel NUC computer (with 16 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD, Wi-Fi adapter), Power Manager PCB, Ethernet Isolation PCB, 24V frame power supply, NEMA enclosure, fan, all connectors, wiring, and cable management components.

- **ASM-300 — Cassette Assembly**: Covers the X-ray detector/cassette hardware.

- **Cables Assembly**: Inter-assembly cabling.

It also includes a **software BOM (SBOM) sheet** listing third-party software dependencies for v3.4.0.

---

### 3. BOM-101 Rev A — MX1 Software System v4.0.1 (Detailed Hardware BOM)
<cite>BOM-101 Rev A</cite>

This is the **most current detailed BOM**, corresponding to **software version v4.0.1**. It covers the same hardware assembly structure as BOM-079 (ASM-100 Emitter, ASM-200 Control Unit, ASM-300 Cassette, and Cables), with the same suppliers, part numbers, and structure. The key difference from BOM-079 is that it accompanies the v4.0.1 software release and includes an updated SBOM for that version's software dependencies.

---

### How the BOMs Relate

| Document | Revision | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| **BOM-055** | Rev G | Top-level shipping/product configuration (what's in the box) |
| **BOM-079** | Rev P | Component-level hardware + SBOM for software v3.4.0 |
| **BOM-101** | Rev A | Component-level hardware + SBOM for software v4.0.1 (current) |

In practice, **BOM-055 Rev G** defines the complete shipped product, referencing sub-BOMs for the Emitter (BOM-004), Cassette (BOM-008), and accessories. **BOM-101 Rev A** is the most current detailed parts list at the component level and reflects the latest software baseline.

question: List every engineering change request in the QMS and its status.
answer:
Here is a complete inventory of all **3 Engineering Change Requests (ECRs)** in the QMS:

---

## ECR Inventory

| ECR | Title | Release Type | Change Type | Reason for Change | Eff. Date | US Regulatory Outcome | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **ECR-577** | MX1 BOM-055 Rev F | V&V | BOM change | V&V complete; performance, reliability & manufacturing improvements; part obsolescence | 2024-10-22 | Letter to File | **Signed / Released** |
| **ECR-587** | MX1 SW v4.0.1 | V&V | Software/Firmware & BOM change | Product improvement (ToF calibration race condition fix; MariaDB directory ownership fix) | 2024-10-14 | No Impact – ECR Assessment Only | **Signed / Released** |
| **ECR-593** | MX1 BOM-055 Rev G | V&V | BOM change | Part replacement (sub-GHz antenna replacement for FCC compliance; pediatric filter removal; label FCC ID correction) | 2024-10-24 | Letter to File | **Signed / Released** |

---

## Details by ECR

### ECR-577 — MX1 BOM-055 Rev F <cite>ECR-577 Rev A</cite>
- **Originator:** M. Khosravanipour
- **Description:** Updated BOM-055 from Rev F-beta to Rev F and released associated V&V reports. MWI-232 PN reference updated to reflect BOM change.
- **Key documents affected:** BOM-055 Rev F, BOM-020 Rev F, MWI-232 Rev F; third-party test reports 3P-P01-32 (SGS IEC 60601-1-2) and 3P-P01-33 (Intertek IEC 60601-1).
- **New V&V required?** Yes — references 3P-P01-32, 3P-P01-33, and VVPR-P01-205.
- **Risk management update?** No — changes did not introduce new requirements or risks.
- **US Regulatory impact:** Letter to File (see MEMO-P01-699).
- **Approved by:** Quality Engineering, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Ops (DCO 24-563).

---

### ECR-587 — MX1 SW v4.0.1 <cite>ECR-587 Rev A</cite>
- **Originator:** Gage Carr
- **Description:** Fixed a race condition in the ToF calibration process causing calibration failures; fixed `/opt/medai/data/mysql` folder ownership to restore remote OS update capability.
- **Key documents affected:** BOM-101 Rev A; firmware S10002–S10006, S10008 (all v4.0.1); OS images SS-10036 & SS-10037 v4.0.1; MEMO-P01-766 and MEMO-P01-765.
- **New V&V required?** No — changes are non-functional infrastructure corrections reviewed by MedAI engineers.
- **Risk management update?** No — no changes to device functionality or existing risk mitigations.
- **US Regulatory impact:** No Impact – ECR Assessment Only.
- **Approved by:** Quality Engineering, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs (DCO 24-599).

---

### ECR-593 — MX1 BOM-055 Rev G <cite>ECR-593 Rev A</cite>
- **Originator:** M. Khosravanipour
- **Description:** Replaced sub-GHz antenna (M50054) with M51184 & M51183 for FCC compliance; relocated WiFi antennas; removed pediatric filter (per regulatory indications update); corrected FCC ID on overshipper labels; updated drawing M11085 (Cassette Catch Plate).
- **Key documents affected:** BOM-055 Rev G, BOM-008 Rev L, BOM-004 Rev K, BOM-037 Rev G, BOM-056 Rev F; multiple drawings, MWIs, DHRs, RSK-P01-012 Rev B (DFMEA), QSR-026 Rev H; MEMO-P01-771 & MEMO-P01-772.
- **New V&V required?** No — new antennas demonstrated functionally equivalent; existing test data sufficient.
- **Risk management update?** Yes — DFMEA (RSK-P01-012) updated to reflect new parts. Pediatric-specific risks to be removed in RSK-P01-010 Rev E (future release).
- **US Regulatory impact:** Letter to File (Flowchart B pathway; new 510(k) not required).
- **Approved by:** Quality Engineering, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Ops (DCO 24-617).

---

**Summary:** All three ECRs are at **Rev A**, fully signed, and effective immediately as of October 2024. All were released under the **V&V** phase. None required a new 510(k) submission.

question: Does the corpus contain a 510(k) summary for the device?
answer:
No, the corpus does **not** contain a standalone 510(k) summary document. After a full inventory of all 165 unique document IDs across 188 documents, there is no document with a type or title corresponding to a 510(k) submission or 510(k) summary.

The corpus does contain references to MedAI's 510(k) activity within other documents:

- **PLN-P01-060 Rev C** (MX1 Project Plan) references FDA 510(k) number **K231372**, which was submitted in April 2023. It also notes that on February 6, 2024, the FDA issued a **"Not Substantially Equivalent" (NSE)** letter, after which MedAI decided to pursue a new 510(k) submission. <cite>PLN-P01-060 Rev C</cite>

- **MEMO-P01-699 Rev A** (Regulatory Assessment for MX1 Rev F Design Changes, now obsolete) references FDA guidance documents related to deciding when to submit a 510(k) for design and software changes. <cite>MEMO-P01-699 Rev A OBSOLETE</cite>

- **PLN-P01-061** (MX1 Regulatory Plan) may contain additional regulatory strategy details, but no 510(k) summary document itself exists in the corpus.

In summary: the 510(k) submission (K231372) is referenced within planning and regulatory documents, but the actual **510(k) summary** is not present in the QMS corpus.
